title: Bioimage Analysis Provenance Convention
description: Schema for the bioimage_analysis: Zarr convention, which records the analysis steps (software, parameters, inputs, environment) that produced or modified a Zarr node. Validates either a Zarr v3 node metadata document (zarr.json) or a bare attributes object (e.g. a Zarr v2 .zattrs file); use #/$defs/attributes to validate attributes only.

zarrV3Node.description: A Zarr v3 node metadata document (zarr.json)

attributes.description: Zarr attributes using the bioimage_analysis: convention (key-prefixed pattern). For Zarr v2 this is the content of .zattrs.

bioimage_analysis:steps.description: REQUIRED. Analysis steps that created or modified this node, in execution order.

conventionMetadata.description: Convention metadata object for use in the zarr_conventions array

schema_url.description: URL to the JSON Schema definition for this convention

spec_url.description: URL to the full specification document

uuid.description: UUID that permanently identifies this convention

name.description: Human-readable name of the convention, matching its namespace prefix

description.const: Provenance of the bioimage analysis steps that produced or modified this node
description.description: Brief description of the convention's purpose and usage

step.description: One execution of one analysis step (a conversion, a processing step, a segmentation, a measurement, ...)

software.description: REQUIRED. The software that performed the step.

name.description: What the step did, e.g. 'Image conversion' or 'Threshold Segmentation'.

id.description: Identifier of this execution, e.g. a UUID or a workflow engine task id. Unique within the steps array.

parameters.description: Parameters the software ran with, ideally after defaults were applied. Free-form.

outputs.description: Data the step wrote, if not only this node.

software.description: A piece of software identified by name and version

name.description: REQUIRED. Name of the software, package or tool.

version.description: REQUIRED. Released version (e.g. '2.1.0'); use the commit if there is no release.

uri.description: Where the software can be found, e.g. its repository or package page.

commit.description: Version-control commit of the software that was run.

workflow.description: The workflow (pipeline) run the step was part of

uri.description: Where the workflow source can be found.

commit.description: Version-control commit of the workflow source.

container.description: Container image the step ran in

engine.description: Container engine, e.g. docker, singularity, apptainer, podman.

digest.description: Content digest of the image, e.g. sha256:<hex>.

dataReference.description: Reference to data read or written by a step. At least one of path, uri or id is required.

path.description: Path of a node relative to the root of this Zarr hierarchy, e.g. 'B/03/0'.

uri.description: URI of data outside this hierarchy.

id.description: Identifier of the data in a catalogue or archive, e.g. a UUID or accession.

checksum.description: Checksum as <algorithm>:<lowercase hex digest>, e.g. sha256:9f86d0...

dateTime.description: ISO 8601 date-time with time zone, e.g. 2026-11-04T11:55:00+01:00
